## History

Billy Andrews drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) to a benefit concert held at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). After the event concluded, he drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) back home while the girls shared supper and reflected on the evening's performances.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Billy is the brother of [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). He drives [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), along with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), to and from the benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where the girls share supper and discuss the evening's events on the ride home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010), +7 more_
